title: CYOA App Intervention for Social Media Use in Adolescents With Depression
official: Choose Your Own Adventure: A Novel Intervention to Regulate Social Media Use in Adolescents With Depression
summary:
This study will develop and test Choose Your Own Adventure, a personalized app-based intervention designed to help adolescents with depression regulate social media use.

Adolescents ages 13 to 17 years with major depressive disorder and daily TikTok use will be randomized to either the CYOA app intervention or no intervention. The CYOA app is designed to detect individualized patterns of problematic social media use and offer personalized options to disrupt "runaway train" social media use.

The study will assess feasibility, acceptability, preliminary effects on social media use and mood, and potential mechanisms including social media self-control failure. Participants will complete baseline, post-intervention, and 3-month follow-up assessments.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 13 to 17 years
* Presence of major depressive disorder, with a current episode of at least 2 months
* Adolescent and parent or guardian speak English
* Adolescent is a current user of social media on a personal cell phone
* Adolescent uses English-language TikTok for at least 2 hours per day on average

Exclusion Criteria:

* Primary psychotic disorder, bipolar disorder, or neurodevelopmental disorder
* Parent or guardian or child does not speak English
* Adolescent does not own a personal cell phone
* Adolescent does not use social media, specifically TikTok, at least 2 hours per day
* Fetuses
* Neonates
* Prisoners
* Adults lacking capacity to consent or adults with diminished capacity to consent
* Non-English speakers
* Individuals unable to read
* Employees of the researcher
* Students of the researcher
* Active members of the military or DoD personnel
* Individuals approached for research participation during a stressful situation, such as an emergency room setting or childbirth
